chapter: Marriage and the end of the shows
title: Marriage hardships and the show breaks up in Pittsburgh
summary: His wife leaves, the show folds in Pittsburgh, and he gets by on money from older women until his jealous wife follows him.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Well, what I should have done, when they let me out of jail, I should have kept running fast as I could, but I was going to be really...you know, I took the thing seriously. I'll get married and have a home, you know, and we'll save money... now, how could you do any of these things with the man not paying you? You were lucky if you got a room and some food, and that's all you got. But one of the things that we got on the TOBA 'Dan, was that--almost like a letter of understanding-- that you respect each other, and very rarely did you ever hear mis- of misuse of trust by any of those persons, 'cause that was a thing that you were really taught, and it was really good.

Now, we went on when we got married and went to Atlanta, went to Norfolk. Well, my wife ran away. She said, "I can't take this. No food..." I tell her, "Come back, I'll make a better home," you know...so then we finally ended up in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. And when we ended up in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, this is when the show broke up.

Now, I knew...I knew how to live...I knew, just like I say, I knew women and I knew that a woman would be nice to you, 'specially if she's older than you, or something like that. And I had to use that. And there were five guys with us and then they looked at me like I was a father, you know, I was the champion of the band... and I'd go out and get money and food and tailor shop and...we were living pretty good in Pittsburgh.

And finally one day my wife, who was very, very jealous, asked me, "Where are you getting this money?" And I told her that I was getting it from Lena Horne's father, Teddy Horne, who lived in Pittsburgh. She followed me one night to this woman's house and she was yellin' all over the place, she was going to kill the woman and kill me and kill herself and all that. We ended up no food, you know, back (laughter)...we ended up back where we started from, you know what I mean, on zero.
